title: Overwrite replaces the folder
prompt: This program writes to the same Parquet folder twice, then saves an ORC copy. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
program:
path = "/tmp/c2/trips"
trips.select("trip_id", "fare", "tip").write.mode("overwrite").parquet(path)
print(spark.read.parquet(path).columns)

trips.select("trip_id", "total").write.mode("overwrite").parquet(path)
back = spark.read.parquet(path)
print(back.columns, back.count())

back.write.mode("overwrite").orc("/tmp/c2/trips_orc")
print(spark.read.orc("/tmp/c2/trips_orc").dtypes)
hints: `columns` lists the column names of what was read, in order.
`overwrite` replaces everything in the folder; it doesn't merge old and new columns or add rows.
ORC stores the schema too, so the types of `back` survive the copy.
